source: CAMIL GE-V-13 · Page 26 · Bedroom and Bathroom (bathroom half)
notes: 'washbowl' dropped: archaic. TO FLUSH normalised to 'flush' — the page lists it with the
infinitive marker attached, which is not how a word is taught. WASTE BASKET to
faucet/tap (grifo) and perfume/cologne (perfume) are collision pairs and stay together.
Cleaning things are here rather than in a house area because they live in this room.

area.name: The Bathroom
area.description: El baño: la ducha y el sanitario, lo que usas para lavarte y arreglarte, y lo que sirve para limpiar.

units.name: The bathroom
units.topic: The fixed things in a bathroom and what you do with them. 'faucet' and 'tap' are the same thing — faucet is American, tap is British

units.name: Washing and hair
units.topic: What you wash with and what you do to your hair afterwards. Toiletries is the general word for all of it

units.name: Teeth and shaving
units.topic: Looking after teeth, and shaving. A blade is the sharp part a razor holds

units.name: Makeup and perfume
units.topic: What goes on the face and skin. 'perfume' and 'cologne' are both perfume — cologne is lighter and traditionally worn by men

units.name: Cleaning
units.topic: What a house is cleaned with, and where the rubbish goes
